serverInfo.name: dsgvo-pro
serverInfo.description: German website compliance platform — 26 laws, 33 scanner modules incl. unique-to-market checks: Hosting-Standort (Schrems II) (Art. 13 lit. f DSGVO), Widerrufsbutton (§356a BGB), KI-Transparenz (Art. 50 KI-VO), Tech-Stack-Aktualität (Art. 32 DSGVO), Anwaltsspezifische Prüfung (BORA / BRAO), Maklerspezifische Prüfung (§34c GewO + MaBV + GEG), Arztspezifische Prüfung (BOÄ + HWG + Art. 9 DSGVO), Finanzvermittler-Prüfung (§34d/f/h/i GewO + FinVermV), Gastronomie-Prüfung (LMIV + PAngV + IfSG), Kosmetik-Prüfung (KosmetikV + HWG + UWG), Bau-/Sanierung-Prüfung (§34c GewO + HwO + MiLoG), Hotel-/Beherbergung-Prüfung (BMG + PAngV + GEG + DSGVO). Laws: DSGVO, KI-VO, BDSG, TDDDG, DDG, BFSG, UWG, BGB, PAngV, VSBG, UrhG, VerpackG, VerpackDG, ElektroG, JuSchG, GewO, MaBV, GEG, BRAO, FinVermV, HwO, IfSG, KosmetikV, HWG, HOAI, MiLoG. Scanner covers: cookie consent, impressum, privacy policy, SSL, accessibility (BFSG), e-commerce (BGB), Widerrufsbutton (§356a BGB), Kündigungsbutton (§312k BGB), hosting-location (Schrems II), dark patterns (UWG), tracking, email marketing, social media, price labeling (PAngV), AI transparency (KI-VO Art. 13/14/50), AI data processing (GDPR Art. 44 ff.), advanced security (GDPR Art. 32), tech-stack staleness (CMS-CVE), plus 8 industry-specific Pro modules: lawyer/Anwalt (BORA/BRAO), real-estate broker/Makler (§34c GewO + MaBV + GEG), physician/Arzt (BOÄ + HWG + Art. 9 GDPR), financial intermediary/Finanzvermittler (§34d/f/h/i GewO + FinVermV), gastronomy (LMIV + PAngV + IfSG), cosmetics studio (KosmetikV + HWG + UWG), construction/renovation (§34c GewO + HwO + MiLoG), hotel/lodging (BMG + PAngV + GEG + GDPR). Auth model: law-lookup tools are free; compliance scans require an API key (free tier 3 scans + 3 API + 3 MCP/month for evaluation at https://dsgvo.pro/api-keys).
